description: This Zenodo deposit publishes measured FM radio spectrum data from Hungary. The describing article identifies the Hungarian National Media and Infocommunications Authority monitoring system, which includes 66 fixed VHF stations, and explains that spectrum measurements are stored as time-by-frequency field-strength matrices in CSV. The FM band is 87.5–108 MHz. The named deposit offers a public FM.zip archive under CC BY 4.0; repository metadata lists a very large package of about 158 GB. Exact stations, dates and sampling steps represented in this particular archive were not established without opening its contents. A modeller could use the measured spectral variation to test broadcast-interference detection or continuity scenarios for radio services. The dataset is field-strength evidence, not a transmitter topology or an outage log. Weather effects may resemble anomalies without causing service failure, as the article cautions. The archive was not downloaded and numerical quality was not assessed. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
name: Hungarian FM Spectrum Measurements Dataset
